briefing.headline: OpenAI and Google DeepMind escalate multi-agent frontier race with new reasoning benchmarks

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race has intensified with multiple frontier labs releasing advanced reasoning models amid surging compute investments. Regulatory scrutiny on safety is rising while commercial deployments accelerate across industries.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI's o4 model and DeepMind's Gemini 3.5 show gains in long-horizon planning; Meta's Llama 4 and xAI's Grok-3 compete on open weights. DeepSeek-V3 undercuts pricing with strong performance.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New NIST guidelines target agentic systems.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp hits 2M units; Microsoft and Google announce $45B combined data center expansions. TSMC reports AI chip shortages persisting into 2027.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first multi-agent system to achieve autonomous scientific discovery trigger an international compute export ban?
